name: City of Thorns
source:
In City of Thorns, you play as an intrepid oracle who's known all over the capital city of Florentia for how accurate your prophecies are. That's why the Sovereign Princess summons you to the palace when her husband is murdered in his sleep. Your task is to figure out which of the people you meet at the palace did the deed - or if none of them did.

[From [url=https://nightroseinteractive.itch.io/city-of-thorns-demo]itch.io[/url]]
